name: mark-as-commitment
description: Founder UI affordance: convert a ticket reply into an explicit substrate commitment. AI-generates a single-line title (haiku) capturing who-commits-what-to-whom-by-when. Threads from_entity (founder person, looked up by email decoded from the request JWT), to_entity (customer_substrate_id), and source_artifact_id (caller-supplied — frontend resolves it via substrate-proxy).
